<!-- pr-reviewer: 8cbd21537d37e647c82f781f2e697115227bdd3b -->
Not built - needs a maintainer look. No blocking code finding remains from this delta review.

This is a delta review of the second refresh head, `8cbd21537d37e647c82f781f2e697115227bdd3b`. The previous review marker is on `3d7a5481683488245324384310c8ea3ef334ad36`.

## What looks good

- The PR's own code diff is unchanged. The mcp source (`crates/app/src/mcp/link.rs`, `link_client.rs`, `listen.rs`) is byte-identical between `61f0b04b7` and `8cbd21537`. The size-limit fix and the token proof are as reviewed.
- The refresh merges are hand-resolved. `cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 3883 --reviewed 3d7a5481` reports DELTA: `61f0b04b` resolved `crates/app/tests/mcp_live/ui_link.rs` and `crates/app/tests/wire_dxf_selection/arcs.rs`; `8cbd2153` resolved `crates/app/tests/wire_dxf_selection/arcs.rs`.
- The hand resolutions are correct. `61f0b04b7` keeps both the false-server test and the unauthenticated-client test. `8cbd21537` takes main's `start_at(...)` form in `arcs.rs`. No conflict markers remain. The final file is coherent.

## Results merged with main

- Trial merge: clean. The head `8cbd21537` already contains the current `origin/main` (`ddee3aed6`). The merge is a no-op. `git diff --check` passed. This ran locally.
- Build, quick gate, mcp suites, clippy, light lane: not run. `crates/app/Cargo.toml:39-43` adds `windows-sys` and `libc`. The PR-reviewer hard rule says not to build a PR that adds dependencies. The author's reported results are not results from this review.

## Targeted tests

- Example catalog: no post or toolpath change.
- Light lane: not run. The PR adds dependencies.

## Requested before merge

1. A maintainer must check the dependency additions in `crates/app/Cargo.toml` (`windows-sys` on Windows, `libc` on Unix) before build verification. This review does not establish a green build.

## Optional, non-blocking

- `docs/decisions/3874-windows-stale-link.md:14` says discovery checks the PID and removes stale files. It does neither. `pid_alive` has no callers. Remove the unused helpers and their dependencies if this feature is not part of the fix. Otherwise, connect the check to discovery and add tests. Update the decision file to match the code.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 0ab7b0802878d47b12dad71c6d9ca1fc9332f91a -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The fix commit `0ab7b0802` removes the unused `pid_alive` helpers and the direct `windows-sys` and `libc` dependencies. The net diff against current main touches 5 files. It changes no `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, `build.rs`, `.github/`, `scripts/`, or `.cargo/` file. The dependency concern from the earlier review is resolved.

## What looks good

- The token proof is mutual. The client sends `token_proof(token, nonce, "client")`. The window answers with `token_proof(token, nonce, "server")`. The raw token does not cross the socket. The comparisons use a constant-time compare.
- `read_answer_line` reads at most `MAX_ANSWER_LINE + 1` bytes. It returns `ReadLineError::TooLong` at once. It does not parse the rest of an oversized line as another message. Three unit tests cover a valid line, an oversized line, and an oversized line without a newline.
- The false-server test proves that the CLI sends no tool call to a peer that does not prove the token.
- `hello_matches` keeps the legacy `token` path for old clients. The decision file records the choice.
- No `unwrap`, `expect`, or `panic` outside tests. No `unsafe`. Every changed file is under 400 lines.

## Results merged with main

- Trial merge with `origin/main` `707dac12a`: clean. No conflicts. `git diff --check` passed. This ran locally.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib mcp::link_client`: 3 passed, 0 failed. Locally.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_live`: 22 passed, 0 failed. This includes all 8 `ui_link` tests. Locally.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean. Locally.

The first debug build failed on a stale seed in `target/debug`. The seed left no `camcraft_geometry` rlib in `deps/`. I removed the seeded debug target and rebuilt. The results above come from the clean rebuild.

## Targeted tests

- Example catalog: no post or toolpath change. No catalog test ran.
- Light lane: green. 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. It ran locally in 2.5 min. The first run timed out during its release build. The retry used the warm release build and passed. The steps cover geometry and motion suites that this PR does not change.
- P1 heavy step: not applicable. This is a P3 PR. It changes no posted G-code, gouge check, collision check, stock simulation, or geometry.

## Requested before merge

None. The earlier size-limit finding is fixed. The dependency additions are gone.

## Questions / notes

- The decision file cites `wire.rs` in its "Cost to change later" section. `crates/app/src/mcp/wire.rs` exists. The citation is correct.

I set the label `merge-ready` and removed `needs-maintainer`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
